global_summary: This video documents a dramatic emergency rescue operation where multiple yellow excavators are deployed to save people from icy, turbulent waters. The footage shows excavators using their buckets as makeshift rescue vehicles to lift individuals—some carrying personal belongings—from freezing rivers or flooded areas to safety on muddy or icy shorelines. The operation involves careful coordination between excavator operators and ground rescuers, with crowds of onlookers and emergency responders assisting survivors. The harsh winter conditions, including overcast skies and snow, emphasize the life-threatening nature of the situation and the critical role of heavy machinery in this unconventional rescue effort.
